lines.text: Claude Code in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.
lines.spoken: Claude Code in Spec With Code: plan, build, review.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init. It adds agents dot M D, and eleven spec weave skills.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode. In setup, keep this computer and click Continue. The Claude card should say Ready to code. If it doesn't, run claude auth login in a terminal first.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code. In setup, keep this computer and click Continue. The Claude card should say: Ready to code. If it doesn't, run claude auth login in a terminal first.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Claude in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Claude in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

lines.text: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Claude writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
lines.spoken: Type a dollar sign, pick S W increment, and describe the change. Claude writes spec dot M D: acceptance criteria, and a task with its files and test.

lines.text: Then send sw-do. Claude claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
lines.spoken: Then send S W do. Claude claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.

lines.text: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.
lines.spoken: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

lines.text: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.
lines.spoken: Next, S W done verifies and closes the increment.
